title: Yara and the Compass
author: Ivo Ashgrove
blurb: Sable Winterbourne, a bush pilot flying medicine and rumors into the interior, keeps moving because stopping costs more. But when a dying prospector trades a map for a promise, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must beat the salvage fleet to the wreck by six tides, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
